cells.note: The talent marketplace page says the mobility module shows employees which internal roles their skills unlock.
The Career Advisor Agent page describes learning content mapped to the skills between a current role and the next role.
The talent marketplace page describes growth plans that map an employee's skills to target roles and close priority gaps.
The development page lists curated role-relevant content; it does not describe a course catalog.
The Career Advisor Agent page describes AI career guidance in Microsoft Teams and the marketplace.
The Task Intelligence page describes identifying tasks within roles that are ready for automation or AI assistance.
The retention and engagement page describes employee career aspirations and development paths for an employer's staff.
